title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of Commander, etc.)
(1) The Commander shall, under the direction of the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and command and supervise units subordinate or attached to the Command.
(2) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and act on behalf of the Commander where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances.
(3) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and coordinate and control staff duties under the direction of the Commander.
